meta.title: Events | The Hague Natural Health Centre | Holistic Health in The Hague
meta.description: The Hague Natural Health Centre is holistic health centre offering alternative, natural therapies including accupuncture, homeopathy, ayurdeva, reiki, yoga, vedic meditation, EMDR, counselling, nutrition, psychology, tissue salts, bach flower essences, men's and women's circles, Trauma Sensitive Yoga (TCTSY) and talks, courses, workshops and events. Contact Founder and Homeopath Sandra Delgado Quist for more information.
